summary.en: A relaxing day at the driving range leads Kogoro, Ran, and Conan to their next explosive case, as the president of a leading electronics manufacturer meets an untimely end. With many suspects and few clues, will Conan unravel the mystery in time to catch a killer? Location: Driving range Victim: Eisuke Tachibana (fatal) and Tatsuya Okubo (not fatal) Age: 56 years old (Eisuke) and 35 years old (Tatsuya) Cause of death: Explosion from golf ball bomb Suspects: Minoru Yasui, Tatsuya Okubo, and Tomofumi Minami While Tachibana was about to swing his golf club, the bomb exploded.
